articles.title: Shocking CCTV: Speeding Auto’s Wheel Comes Off, Vehicle Flips Into Air and Crashes Into Bike in Beed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre road accident was reported from the Balpir area of Beed on the Beed–Ahilyanagar National Highway, where a speeding autorickshaw lost its front wheel and crashed into an oncoming motorcycle.

body.html:
A bizarre road accident was reported from the Balpir area of Beed on the Beed–Ahilyanagar National Highway, where a speeding autorickshaw lost its front wheel and crashed into an oncoming motorcycle.

According to reports, the incident occurred when the clamp of the autorickshaw’s left wheel broke, causing the wheel to detach while the vehicle was moving at high speed. The sudden failure caused the auto to lose balance and veer out of control.

CCTV footage of the accident shows the autorickshaw being thrown into the air after the wheel came off before colliding with an oncoming motorcycle. The impact injured the biker as well as passengers travelling in the autorickshaw.

Three to four people were reportedly injured in the accident. Locals rushed to the spot immediately after the crash and helped the injured before further assistance arrived.

The shocking incident, which took place in the Ahilyanagar area of Beed district, was captured on CCTV cameras and the video has since gone viral on social media, leaving many viewers stunned.

The accident has once again raised concerns about reckless driving, poor vehicle maintenance and the rising number of road accidents across India.

articles.title: Teen Shot by Friend in Unnao Village; Accused on the Run as Police Launch Manhunt
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 19-year-old youth was shot and seriously injured on Wednesday afternoon in the Unnao district under the Achalganj police station area. The injured youth, Lavkush Yadav, has been admitted to the Community Health Center Achalganj, where he is undergoing treatment in critical condition.

body.html:
A 19-year-old youth was shot and seriously injured on Wednesday afternoon in the Unnao district under the Achalganj police station area. The injured youth, Lavkush Yadav, has been admitted to the Community Health Center Achalganj, where he is undergoing treatment in critical condition.

According to police, a call was received through Dial 112 at around 3 pm reporting that a youth had been shot in Gharsil Purva village. Police from Achalganj police station immediately reached the spot.

The injured youth was identified as Lavkush Yadav (19), son of Ramkesh Yadav and a resident of Tigra village. He was rushed to the Achalganj CHC for treatment. During first aid, doctors found a bullet injury below his abdomen. He is currently under medical supervision.

Following the incident, a large number of villagers gathered at the scene.

Preliminary investigation revealed that the accused is Chandan Nishad (20), son of Ram Kishan, a resident of Gharsil Purva village. After allegedly firing the shot, the accused fled from the spot. Police teams have launched a search operation in the village and nearby areas to arrest him.

Local residents told police that Lavkush and the accused Chandan were friends. Investigators are trying to determine whether the shooting was the result of a personal dispute or some other motive.

Police have inspected the scene, collected evidence and started recording statements of nearby residents. Officials said the exact reason behind the incident will become clear only after the investigation is completed. Further legal action will be taken once a formal complaint is received.

articles.title: Speeding Audi Mows Down Foreign Woman in Zirakpur, Dies on Spot; Driver on the Run
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A foreign woman was killed in a late-night road accident in Zirakpur after a speeding Audi car allegedly ran her over on VIP Road near M‑Care Hospital around midnight.

body.html:
A foreign woman was killed in a late-night road accident in Zirakpur after a speeding Audi car allegedly ran her over on VIP Road near M‑Care Hospital around midnight.

According to eyewitnesses, the victim, identified as Mavluda, had come to the hospital with her friend Abhishek alias Abhi to visit a patient. After leaving the hospital, the two were walking along the main road when a black Audi car, reportedly moving at high speed, struck Mavluda while she was crossing the road.

The impact was so severe that she was thrown nearly 14 feet into the air and landed on the other side of the road. She suffered critical injuries and died on the spot due to heavy bleeding. Abhishek, who was walking with her, sustained minor injuries.

Abhishek told police that Mavluda had come to the hospital to check on his pregnant wife who had been admitted there. As they stepped outside and approached the road, the speeding vehicle suddenly hit them.

Local residents informed the police control room soon after the accident. However, some witnesses alleged that police reached the spot nearly an hour later, which led to anger among people gathered at the scene.

Police later took the body into custody and sent it to the mortuary at the Civil Hospital in Dera Bassi. Officials are now examining CCTV footage from nearby cameras to identify the Audi driver.

Investigating officer Raj Kumar said the deceased has been identified as a foreign national. Her sister is currently travelling from Turkey to India, and further procedures, including the post-mortem, will be conducted after her arrival.

Incident occurred on 08 March 2026 (Monday)

articles.title: Cow Smuggling Allegation Sparks Tension in Muzaffarnagar, Police Issue Clarification
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Uttar Pradesh’s Muzaffarnagar district, some Hindu organisations accused a man named Akbar of smuggling cows. However, police clarified that Akbar had legally purchased the cow from another village and was taking it to his home.

body.html:
In Uttar Pradesh’s Muzaffarnagar district, some Hindu organisations accused a man named Akbar of smuggling cows.

However, police clarified that Akbar had legally purchased the cow from another village and was taking it to his home. The Purkaji Police Station investigated the matter and found no evidence of cow smuggling or cow slaughter.

Officials said the cow is currently at Akbar’s house along with his other cattle. Further legal proceedings are underway.

articles.title: Racial Slurs, Belt Assault Near Saket Court: Delhi Park Attack on Northeast Women Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A case has been registered by the Delhi Police after a woman from Manipur was allegedly assaulted near the Saket District Court Complex in south Delhi on Sunday evening. According to police, the incident took place when the victim and her friends were walking in a park in Malviya Nagar.

body.html:
A case has been registered by the Delhi Police after a woman from Manipur was allegedly assaulted near the Saket District Court Complex in south Delhi on Sunday evening.

According to police, the incident took place when the victim and her friends were walking in a park in Malviya Nagar. A group of youths allegedly passed inappropriate and racially derogatory remarks at them. When the woman objected, the situation escalated into a confrontation and the group allegedly attacked the victims.

Preliminary accounts state that the woman from Manipur and her friend, a transgender person from Assam, were allegedly punched and beaten with belts while the attackers hurled abusive slurs. Another woman from Assam was also reportedly targeted during the incident.

The injured victim was taken to Safdarjung Hospital, where doctors confirmed that she sustained minor injuries and is currently recovering.

Police said a criminal case has been registered under relevant sections of the law and multiple teams have been deployed to identify and apprehend the accused. Officials added that they are in constant touch with the victim and are providing necessary assistance as the investigation continues.

On Monday, police also apprehended four minors in connection with the alleged assault. Authorities said further action will be taken based on the victim’s statement.

The incident has triggered strong reactions from leaders in the Northeast. Conrad K. Sangma condemned the attack, describing it as racial bullying against people from the Northeast and urged strict action against those responsible.

In a post on X, Sangma wrote that repeated attacks on people from the Northeast in mainland India were “sickening” and called on authorities to ensure that racial bullying does not become the “new normal”.

Police sources said the victims had also reportedly faced similar verbal harassment in the locality on previous occasions.

The case comes just days after another incident of alleged racial abuse in Delhi, where a man identified as Harsh Singh was booked following a dispute with three women from Arunachal Pradesh living in a rented apartment in south Delhi.

According to police, the dispute began on February 20 when the women had called an electrician to install an air conditioner in their fourth-floor flat. During drilling work, dust and debris reportedly fell into the apartment below, leading to objections from Singh and his wife, Ruby Jain.

The women later alleged that the couple abused them and made racist remarks, including calling them “gutter-chaap” and telling them to “go and sell momos”.

The recent assault near the Saket court complex has once again raised concerns over the safety of people from the Northeast living in the national capital. Police said the investigation into the latest case is ongoing.

articles.title: ‘Pay ₹5 Lakh or Face Defamation’: Jhansi Woman Alleges Harassment, Social Media Threats
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sensational case has emerged from the Shivaji Nagar area under the Navabad police station limits in Jhansi, where a woman has levelled serious allegations of harassment, threats and attempted defamation against some neighbours, including women working in orchestras and their associates.

body.html:
A sensational case has emerged from the Shivaji Nagar area under the Navabad police station limits in Jhansi, where a woman has levelled serious allegations of harassment, threats and attempted defamation against some neighbours, including women working in orchestras and their associates.

According to the complaint, the victim alleged that the accused often create disturbances in the locality late at night after consuming alcohol. They are accused of shouting abusive language, playing loud music and creating a ruckus outside her house. A video related to the incident has also surfaced, triggering widespread discussion in the area.

As per reports, Radha Yadav, wife of Krishna Yadav, who lives near BGN School in Shivaji Nagar, stated in her police complaint that Pragya Yadav alias Mohini Yadav and her partner Golu alias Gola Balmiki, residents of the same area, have been constantly harassing her.

Radha alleged that Pragya Yadav, using her Instagram account under the name “Mohini Yadav”, has been sending objectionable videos, photos and messages to her Instagram account. She further claimed that attempts are being made to defame her by sharing her mobile number on WhatsApp and other social media platforms.

According to the victim, when she contacted Pragya Yadav and asked her to stop such acts, the accused allegedly threatened to kill her. Radha also alleged that the accused demanded ₹5 lakh, saying that if the money was paid, they would stop posting videos about her on Instagram.

She further claimed that the accused boasted about having strong contacts and warned that they could do anything to harm her.

In her complaint, Radha also alleged that some women in the neighbourhood who work as orchestra dancers regularly drink alcohol with friends late at night and create chaos in the colony. She claimed they dance to loud music, use abusive language and sometimes even kick the gate of her house in an attempt to break it. Stones have also reportedly been thrown at her house, creating panic among her family members.

Residents of the area are said to be troubled by these repeated disturbances.

The victim said she had earlier complained about the issue. Even on the night of the incident, she reportedly called the police, but according to her, no concrete help was received. Radha alleged that around 10 boys and 10 girls frequently gather in the colony late at night, creating trouble and sometimes entering nearby houses, which has caused distress among local residents.

She claims to possess evidence related to the entire incident.

articles.title: Speeding MUV Drags Scooter for 100 Metres in Bengaluru — Vehicle Bursts Into Flames on Busy Road
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A late-night accident on Jayamahal Main Road in RT Nagar, Bengaluru, turned dramatic on Saturday after a gearless scooter caught fire when it was hit by a speeding multi-utility vehicle (MUV) and dragged along the road for over 100 metres.

body.html:
A late-night accident on Jayamahal Main Road in RT Nagar, Bengaluru, turned dramatic on Saturday after a gearless scooter caught fire when it was hit by a speeding multi-utility vehicle (MUV) and dragged along the road for over 100 metres.

The scooter rider, identified as Roopa from Sanjaynagar, sustained minor injuries and was rushed to a hospital for treatment, police said.

The entire incident was captured on a CCTV camera. The footage shows the MUV ramming into the scooter, which then got trapped beneath the vehicle’s front-left wheel. Despite the collision, the driver continued driving, dragging the crushed scooter for nearly 100 metres along the busy stretch.

During the drag, petrol began leaking from the scooter’s damaged fuel tank. Moments later, the scooter suddenly caught fire, with flames erupting on the road.

According to RT Nagar traffic police, the driver of the MUV fled the scene immediately after the crash.

Police have launched a search for the vehicle and its driver. Authorities are currently reviewing CCTV footage from the surrounding area to identify the MUV and trace the person responsible for the hit-and-run incident.

articles.title: CCTV Horror on Nalgonda Highway: Speeding Car Ploughs Into Sanitation Worker and Scooter Rider
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious road accident was caught on CCTV on Hyderabad Road in Nalgonda, Telangana, after a speeding car rammed into municipal sanitation workers and a scooter rider near Unlimited Shopping Mall, leaving two people critically injured.

body.html:
A serious road accident was caught on CCTV on Hyderabad Road in Nalgonda, Telangana, after a speeding car rammed into municipal sanitation workers and a scooter rider near Unlimited Shopping Mall, leaving two people critically injured.

The incident occurred in the early hours of Monday while sanitation workers of the Nalgonda Municipal Corporation were sweeping the roadside near the shopping complex on the Nalgonda–Hyderabad highway.

According to preliminary information, the car lost control and struck a woman sanitation worker who was cleaning waste along the roadside. The vehicle also hit a youth travelling on a scooter nearby before overturning due to the impact.

The woman sanitation worker suffered fractures in both legs, while the scooter rider sustained severe head injuries and is said to be in critical condition.

Locals rushed to help the injured and alerted emergency services. Both victims were initially shifted to the Nalgonda Government Hospital for treatment. The two-wheeler rider was later moved to a private hospital for advanced care.

Residents have alleged over-speeding and negligence by the driver. Police reached the spot and the car driver has been taken into custody by the Two Town police for questioning.

A case has been registered and further investigation into the incident is underway.
